title: Stage 05 reconstruction - relation v2 adaptive recovery series R0 through R6
declaration: This is an adaptive experiment series, not a set of independent experiments.

Every round after R0 was designed after reading the failure mode of the round before it, and in several cases the amendment authorising the next round quotes that failure mode verbatim as its justification.

Consequently NO metric reported by ANY round of this series - including the terminal R6 - is an unbiased estimator of out-of-sample performance. Every reported value is conditioned on all previously observed outcomes.

No family-wise error rate control, Bonferroni correction, alpha-spending schedule or any other multiplicity correction was pre-registered or applied at any point in the series. The nominal per-round gate thresholds are therefore not the effective error rates of the series.
The correct reading of a passing round is 'the last configuration tried did not fail the gates', not 'the configuration generalises'.

series_extent.note_on_count: Eight numbered recovery attempts (R0, R1, R2, R3, R4, R4B, R4C, R5) plus the terminal R6, nine entries in total. The audit's headline figure of eight rounds counts R4/R4B/R4C as a single R4 family.
series_extent.note_on_density: Six terminal round results plus the R5 development freeze landed on a single calendar day, 2026-07-16. Timezone caution: commits on 2026-07-18 mix -0300 and +0000 author offsets, so naive string ordering of that day misleads by three hours.

holdout_and_benchmark_consumption.summary: Only two rounds ever consumed a local holdout. R0 through R4C ran entirely on the sealed 6,005-pair Paris4 development edge set; the holdout was consumed once by R5 and once by R6, and both consumed the SAME holdout, local_holdout_v2.

development_cohort.note: The same 6,005 pairs were re-analysed eight times with model families and fold builders chosen in response to earlier results on those same pairs. This is the dominant source of optimistic bias in the series.

local_holdout_v1.outcome: NEVER CONSUMED BY ANY ROUND. It was abandoned at a label-noise blocker before an execution claim was created (v19_execution_claim_created: false, v19_r5_output_read: false; PHASE2_RESULTS.json:193-194).
local_holdout_v1.correction_to_audit: docs/PIPELINE_AUDIT_20260724.md FIX-15 states that local_holdout_v1 and v2 were both consumed. Only v2 was. The shared-geometry aggravating factor the audit describes is nonetheless real and is recorded below.

local_holdout_v2.note: R6 is a second consumption of a holdout that R5 had already been executed against and failed on. A holdout consumed twice is not a holdout for the second consumer.

rounds.different_kind_note: R6 is NOT a comparable eighth trial of the same experiment. R0 through R5 fitted probabilistic classifiers with learned parameters and were judged on calibration and recall. R6 is a deterministic two-stream geometry-agreement rule with no learned parameters and no probabilities, which abstains unless two implementations agree exactly. Its 1600/1600 and its ECE of 0.0 are structural properties of that construction, not measurements. Tabulating R6 next to R0-R5 as if it were the round that finally worked misrepresents all eight.

estimand_redefinition.finding: The metric named 'ece' does not denote the same quantity across the series, and the change was never declared.
estimand_redefinition.in_R0_through_R5: A genuine expected-calibration-error bootstrap upper confidence bound over a probabilistic classifier's predicted probabilities, gated at <= 0.05. It terminated R0 (0.058966), R1 (0.063847) and R2 (0.062115).
estimand_redefinition.in_R6: Computed as _ece(np.ones(len(pair_ids)), correct) - every confidence fixed to the literal 1.0. All samples fall in the last bin of the 15-bin reliability diagram, so the statistic collapses to |accuracy - 1.0| exactly. The gate was also loosened from 0.05 to 0.10.
estimand_redefinition.consequence: R6's reported ece of 0.0 is a restatement of relation_accuracy == 1.0 and carries no calibration information whatsoever. It is not comparable to the R0/R1/R2 values and must never appear in the same column as them.
remediation: The ece gate has been removed from GATES in framework/stages/05-reconstruction/scripts/evaluate_r6_direct_geometry.py.
The metric is now reported as accuracy_on_all_pairs, which is what it measured.
The _ece helper has been deleted, since its only caller passed a constant.
Emitted constraints now carry the per-decision geometric band margin instead of a constant 1.0 confidence, tagged confidence_semantics: UNCALIBRATED_GEOMETRIC_BAND_MARGIN.

The frozen receipt R6_LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_RESULTS.json is NOT edited. It is hash-bound by R6_LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_CLOSEOUT.json artifact_sha256 and remains the immutable record of what was actually run. Only future runs of the evaluator change.

circularity_of_the_r6_functional_metrics.finding: R6's 100 percent functional metrics are circular by construction. The decision bands the policy applies are the same literals used by the assigner that generated the labels it is scored against.
circularity_of_the_r6_functional_metrics.correct_interpretation: A score of 1.0 demonstrates that an independent reimplementation reproduces the label generator's own rule. It does not demonstrate that the winding relation is recovered correctly, and it is not evidence about any surface outside this frozen geometry.

non_claims: This declaration does not invalidate any individual round; it states the conditions under which the numbers may be read.
This declaration does not establish that a corrected series would have produced a different outcome.
This declaration does not establish correct geometry, ink, letters, or First Letters.
This declaration makes no external generalization claim.
corrections_to_the_source_audit: docs/PIPELINE_AUDIT_20260724.md FIX-15 states that local_holdout_v1 and local_holdout_v2 were both consumed by the series. Only local_holdout_v2 was consumed. local_holdout_v1 was abandoned at a label-noise blocker before any execution claim existed. The shared-frozen-geometry concern the audit raises is nonetheless correct and is documented above.

The audit attributes the R0/R1/R2 terminations to the same degenerate ECE that R6 reports. They were terminated by a real calibration UCB on a probabilistic model. The defect is that R6 reused the name for a different quantity, which is a stronger finding, not a weaker one.
R3's calibration gate PASSED at 0.049899. R3 was terminated by an R0-proposal recall ceiling. The audit's framing of the series as uniformly calibration-limited is inaccurate.
R4 and R4B never computed an ECE at all; both terminated at the fold audit before any model was fitted.
